newsitem.title: USA: PG&E HITS RECORD POWER DEMAND IN CALIF..
newsitem.headline: PG&E HITS RECORD POWER DEMAND IN CALIF..

text.p: Pacific Gas & Electric Co (PG&E) said high energy demand due to scorching temperatures in northern and central California pushed electric demand on its system to a record peak Wednesday.
PG&E said in a statement that a preliminary estimate showed yesterday's peak load reaching at least 21,450 megawatts (MW), up from the previous peak of 21,437 MW set Aug 12, 1996.
PG&E said it expects electricity demand to remain high as the hot temperatures continue to bake California. However, it has sufficient resources in place to meet the forecast demand.
PG&E, a subsidiary of San Francisco-based PG&E Corp, serves nearly 13 million people in northern and central California.
